description: Use this when the user asks who is favoured in one game, by how much, or how the two sides compare for it. Returns the pre-game win probability and projected margin, the consensus spread and total, the teams compared, leaders, recent form and who is out; signed in, also the market's vig-free chance, the model against it and the line, and the head-to-head; with Keel Stats Pro the absence costs, position matchups, records against the close and key players, and with `detail` "full" the model's factor weights. The answer's `account.held` names what the caller's plan left out. Needs a game_id from tonight_slate or find_game. Not for picks or betting advice: Keel Stats gives neither.

detail.description: "compact" (default) or "full" (Keel Stats Pro): adds the model's factor weights and strengths.

game_id.description: Numeric game ID (from tonight_slate, find_game or team_profile).

include_breakdown.description: Older form of detail "full": true adds the model factor weights (requires Keel Stats Pro).

name: game_projection
